title: ICC told to assess whether Duterte’s ‘kill’ remarks are a Visayan quirk
summary: MANILA, Philippines — The International Criminal Court (ICC) should determine if former President Rodrigo Duterte’s “kill” remarks are just a Visayan way of emphasis, which has been “misread” by…

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The International Criminal Court (ICC) should determine if former President Rodrigo Duterte’s “kill” remarks are just a Visayan way of emphasis, which has been “misread” by outsiders in Manila and abroad. This was contained in a 77-page pretrial filing of Duterte dated November 25, by his defense lawyer Peter Haynes, as his camp accused the prosecution of “isolating inflammatory passages,” which was then used as evidence in filing of three counts of alleged crimes against humanity against the accused.
